cards.name: Total Pipeline Value
cards.description: Total value of all opportunities in pipeline

native.query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) as total_pipeline
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')
  AND ({{pipeline_stage}} IS NULL OR pipeline_stage = {{pipeline_stage}})
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})
  AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]

cards.name: Qualified Leads This Month
cards.description: Number of qualified leads generated this month

native.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as qualified_leads
FROM crm_data 
WHERE lead_score >= 70 
  AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW())
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'closed_won' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
         NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 2
    ) as conversion_rate
FROM crm_data 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})

SELECT ROUND(AVG(deal_value)::numeric, 0) as avg_deal_size
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status = 'closed_won' 
  AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})

cards.name: Pipeline by Stage
cards.description: Distribution of deals across pipeline stages

native.query:
SELECT 
    pipeline_stage,
    COUNT(*) as deal_count,
    SUM(deal_value) as stage_value
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')
  AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})
GROUP BY pipeline_stage
ORDER BY 
  CASE pipeline_stage 
    WHEN 'Discovery' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Qualification' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Proposal' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Negotiation' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Closing' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END

cards.name: Lead Sources Performance
cards.description: Lead quality and volume by source

native.query:
SELECT 
    source,
    COUNT(*) as total_leads,
    ROUND(AVG(lead_score)::numeric, 1) as avg_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'closed_won' THEN 1 END) as won_deals,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'closed_won' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
       NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1
    ) as win_rate
FROM crm_data 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY avg_score DESC

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('week', closed_date) as week,
    SUM(deal_value) as revenue,
    COUNT(*) as deals_closed
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status = 'closed_won' 
  AND closed_date >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', closed_date)
ORDER BY week

cards.name: Deal Aging Analysis
cards.description: Deals by age in current pipeline stage

native.query:
SELECT 
    pipeline_stage,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXTRACT(days FROM (NOW() - stage_entered_at)) <= 7 THEN '0-7 days'
      WHEN EXTRACT(days FROM (NOW() - stage_entered_at)) <= 14 THEN '8-14 days'
      WHEN EXTRACT(days FROM (NOW() - stage_entered_at)) <= 30 THEN '15-30 days'
      WHEN EXTRACT(days FROM (NOW() - stage_entered_at)) <= 60 THEN '31-60 days'
      ELSE '60+ days'
    END as age_bucket,
    COUNT(*) as deal_count,
    SUM(deal_value) as total_value
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')
  AND stage_entered_at IS NOT NULL
  AND ({{pipeline_stage}} IS NULL OR pipeline_stage = {{pipeline_stage}})
GROUP BY pipeline_stage, age_bucket
ORDER BY pipeline_stage, 
  CASE age_bucket
    WHEN '0-7 days' THEN 1
    WHEN '8-14 days' THEN 2
    WHEN '15-30 days' THEN 3
    WHEN '31-60 days' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END

cards.name: Sales Forecast
cards.description: Projected revenue based on current pipeline

native.query:
SELECT 
    pipeline_stage,
    COUNT(*) as deal_count,
    SUM(deal_value) as total_value,
    ROUND(SUM(deal_value * win_probability / 100.0)::numeric, 0) as weighted_forecast
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')
  AND ({{pipeline_stage}} IS NULL OR pipeline_stage = {{pipeline_stage}})
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})
GROUP BY pipeline_stage
ORDER BY 
  CASE pipeline_stage 
    WHEN 'Discovery' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Qualification' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Proposal' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Negotiation' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Closing' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END

cards.name: Top Opportunities
cards.description: Highest value deals in the pipeline

native.query:
SELECT 
    company_name,
    pipeline_stage,
    deal_value,
    win_probability,
    ROUND((deal_value * win_probability / 100.0)::numeric, 0) as weighted_value,
    EXTRACT(days FROM (NOW() - created_at)) as days_in_pipeline
FROM crm_data 
WHERE status NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')
  AND ({{pipeline_stage}} IS NULL OR pipeline_stage = {{pipeline_stage}})
  AND ({{lead_source}} IS NULL OR source = {{lead_source}})
ORDER BY deal_value DESC
LIMIT 10
